items.titleEn: OpenAI Reveals Next Flagship Model "Astra" — Solves 10 Unsolved Math Problems
items.summaryEn: OpenAI announced that an internal version of its next flagship model "Astra" achieved new results on 10 unsolved problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science. items.titleEn: Generative AI Adoption Rate: That Job Category Exceeds IT Professionals
items.summaryEn: Generative AI adoption rates vary significantly by job function and industry. A survey by Ragzas revealed that engineers and IT professionals do not rank first in generative AI usage by job category, with another role surprisingly surpassing them.
items.whyItMattersEn: Understanding which job categories drive generative AI adoption helps organizations prioritize training and tool deployment strategies.
items.actionItemEn: Review your organization's generative AI adoption by job category to identify underutilized teams and provide targeted support.
items.pickerCommentEn: The finding that non-technical roles may be adopting generative AI at higher rates challenges assumptions about tech-first adoption patterns.

items.title: Shadow AI（シャドーAI）
items.summary: シャドーAI（人工知能）は、会社やIT部門が正式に承認していないAIツールやAIサービスを従業員が利用する行為だ。大まかには社有端末から非承認のAIを使う場合と、私的端末上のAIを業務に使う場合に分けられる。
items.whyItMatters: シャドーAI（人工知能）は、会社やIT部門が正式に承認していないAIツールやAIサービスを従業員が利用する行為だ。大まかには社有端末から非承認のAIを使う場合と、私的端末上のAIを業務に使う場合
items.summaryEn: Shadow AI refers to employees using unapproved AI tools or services without formal authorization from their company or IT department. It broadly divides into two categories: using unauthorized AI on company devices and using AI on personal devices for work purposes.
items.whyItMattersEn: Shadow AI poses security, compliance, and data governance risks that organizations must address through policy and monitoring.
items.actionItemEn: Develop a shadow AI detection and management strategy, including approval workflows for authorized AI tools.
items.pickerCommentEn: Organizations need to balance restrictive policies with legitimate business needs to effectively manage shadow AI adoption.

The agent operates on Google's cloud infrastructure even when PCs are powered down or smartphones are locked, processing tasks in response to triggers and leveraging login credentials and saved passwords for web interactions.

items.titleEn: "AI Is Actually Useless" Problem — Salesforce's Correct Answer Through Handling 4.31 Million Cases
items.summaryEn: While AI agent adoption advances widely, only about 40% of companies achieve organization-wide profit improvements. Salesforce broke through this "AI adoption barrier" by completing 4.31 million customer interactions through internal practice (Customer Zero), increasing deal volume by 40-50%. The company demonstrates why clear ROI is achievable when data and KPIs are aligned.

items.summaryEn: As generative AI advances, concerns about document tampering risk intensify, making document authenticity verification increasingly critical for enterprises. However, over half of timestamp users cite "difficulty processing large-scale data" as a challenge, creating an urgent need to balance security with processing performance.

items.titleEn: GMO and Amazon's "Quantification" Limits — Why Measuring Productivity in the AI Era Distorts Operations
items.summaryEn: Productivity evaluation in the AI era is faltering, with examples including keystroke monitoring of PC operations and performance assessments based on AI consumption. This piece explores the limitations of numerical management and operational distortions it creates, while proposing evaluation approaches suited to modern organizations.
items.whyItMattersEn: Numerical productivity metrics designed for the pre-AI era are proving counterproductive, leading to perverse incentives and organizational dysfunction.
items.actionItemEn: Audit your organization's productivity metrics and replace keystroke-based or consumption-based measures with outcome-focused alternatives.
items.pickerCommentEn: The shift from input metrics to outcome metrics reflects a deeper organizational maturity needed for sustainable AI integration.
